name: Kilnfire Terraces
core_rationale: Upper stepped terracotta rim of Sola's ceramic shield where giant pottery kilns vent warm updrafts toward the eastern root-train viaduct.
local_conflict: Cracked porcelain golems and whistling kettle-sprites have blocked the Kettle-Whistle Viaduct leading to Continent 02.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Superheated porcelain glaze-steam billows from the northern Slag Chasm; the Guild of Potters has sealed the bridge until the Great Damper is cooled.

causal_continuity.evidence: Forms the upper eastern rim of Continent 01 Hearthbloom Basin connecting Teacup Meadows to the Kettle-Whistle Viaduct.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Stepped terracotta amphitheaters, whistling teapot kilns, and glazed porcelain viaduct bastions.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Terrace steps capped at 0.18 meters with 14.0 meter main kiln highways and 0.25m grass for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Orthogonal 2x2 grid with Kilnwatch Bastion [0,1], Cinder Apron [1,1], and Slag Chasm [1,0] (Fog of Lore) plus Level 12 to 20 construct/spirit spawns.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Seals the northern Slag Chasm frontier with a fog_of_lore portal and Guild of Potters rumor.
